collector_sources.provenance.ps1:
param([string]$ApplicationRoot,[string]$OutputPath)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
Set-Location -LiteralPath $ApplicationRoot
. (Join-Path $ApplicationRoot 'engine/WinBookSplit.Runtime.ps1')
$attempts=New-Object 'Collections.Generic.List[object]'
$registrations=@(Get-WinBookSplitRegisteredManagerPaths -ApplicationRoot $ApplicationRoot -Attempts $attempts -TimeoutSeconds 5 -WithRegistration)
if($registrations.Count -ne 1){throw 'Expected this host existing sole python.org registration'}
$listing=Invoke-WinBookSplitManagerListing -Registration $registrations[0] -ApplicationRoot $ApplicationRoot -TimeoutSeconds 5
$paths=@(ConvertFrom-WinBookSplitPythonListing -Probe $listing -Kind Manager)
$details=@(foreach($path in $paths){
$normal=$null;$normalFailure=$null
try {$normal=Get-WinBookSplitTrustedPath -Path $path -Automatic}catch{$normalFailure=$_.Exception.Message}
$canonical=[WinBookSplit.Preflight.Probe]::Canonical($path)
$metadataPath=Join-Path ([IO.Path]::GetDirectoryName($path)) '__install__.json'
$metadata=Get-Content -LiteralPath $metadataPath -Raw
[ordered]@{Path=$path;Canonical=$canonical;AutomaticTrustedPath=$normal;AutomaticFailure=$normalFailure;Hardlinks=@(& fsutil.exe hardlink list $path);Metadata=$metadata;Pep514InstallPath=(Get-ItemProperty -LiteralPath 'HKCU:\Software\Python\PythonCore\3.14\InstallPath'|Select-Object '(default)',ExecutablePath,WindowedExecutablePath);Sha256=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()}
})
$receipt=[ordered]@{Kind='ACTUAL_WINDOWS11_PYTHONORG_MANAGED_PROVENANCE';Shell=$PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString();ExecutionPolicy=(Get-ExecutionPolicy).ToString();Registration=$registrations;Listing=$listing;RuntimeDetails=$details;Limitations=@('Listing+read-only metadata inspection, not setup or native Store acceptance','fsutil used solely for bounded single-known-file read-only hardlink enumeration')}
$json=$receipt|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 15
$json=$json.Replace($env:USERPROFILE.Replace('\','\\'),'<USERPROFILE>').Replace($env:USERPROFILE,'<USERPROFILE>').Replace($ApplicationRoot.Replace('\','\\'),'<WORKSPACE>').Replace($ApplicationRoot,'<WORKSPACE>')
[IO.File]::WriteAllText($OutputPath,$json+"`n",(New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
[ordered]@{Output=$OutputPath;Paths=$paths;LinkInfo=$details}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6
collector_sources.listed-runtime-component.ps1:
param([string]$ApplicationRoot,[string]$OutputPath)
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
Set-Location -LiteralPath $ApplicationRoot
. (Join-Path $ApplicationRoot 'engine/WinBookSplit.Runtime.ps1')
$attempts=New-Object 'Collections.Generic.List[object]'
$registrations=@(Get-WinBookSplitRegisteredManagerPaths -ApplicationRoot $ApplicationRoot -Attempts $attempts -TimeoutSeconds 5 -WithRegistration)
$listing=Invoke-WinBookSplitManagerListing -Registration $registrations[0] -ApplicationRoot $ApplicationRoot -TimeoutSeconds 5
$paths=@(ConvertFrom-WinBookSplitPythonListing -Probe $listing -Kind Manager)
$probeResults=@(foreach($path in $paths){
$runtimeAttempts=New-Object 'Collections.Generic.List[object]'
$selected=Test-WinBookSplitPythonCandidate -Path $path -Source manager -ApplicationRoot $ApplicationRoot -Attempts $runtimeAttempts -TimeoutSeconds 5 -InterpreterOnly
[ordered]@{VerificationOnlyListedPath=$path;Selected=$selected;Attempts=$runtimeAttempts}
})
$receipt=[ordered]@{Kind='ACTUAL_WINDOWS11_PYTHONORG_LISTED_RUNTIME_COMPONENT';Shell=$PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString();Policy=(Get-ExecutionPolicy).ToString();SourceSha256=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath (Join-Path $ApplicationRoot 'engine/WinBookSplit.Runtime.ps1') -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant();ProbeResults=$probeResults;Limitations=@('Individual independently listed runtime verification only; no controller-selected automatic/setup input','Not native Store, Windows10, setup or exact-ZIP acceptance')}
$json=$receipt|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 15
$json=$json.Replace($env:USERPROFILE.Replace('\','\\'),'<USERPROFILE>').Replace($env:USERPROFILE,'<USERPROFILE>').Replace($ApplicationRoot.Replace('\','\\'),'<WORKSPACE>').Replace($ApplicationRoot,'<WORKSPACE>')
[IO.File]::WriteAllText($OutputPath,$json+"`n",(New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false)))
[ordered]@{Output=$OutputPath;Results=@($probeResults|ForEach-Object { [ordered]@{Accepted=($null -ne $_.Selected);Attempts=$_.Attempts}})} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5
